articles.summary: Karman announced it will open a new, state-of-the-art-facility in the greater Salt Lake City, Utah area to expand its advanced UAS launcher systems and SRM nozzle production capacity to meet substantial increases in customer demand
articles.title: Karman Space & Defense Expands Production Capacity to Support Critical Pentagon Missile and UAS Programs

articles.summary: Karman’s Board selects proven defense leader Jon Rambeau, former president, Communications & Spectrum Dominance for L3 Harris Technologies, as CEO, effective March 23, 2026.
articles.title: Karman Space & Defense Names Jon Rambeau as Chief Executive Officer to Lead Company’s Next Phase of Growth
